task1.title: Average price per kilometre of clothing imported into the EU, 1997 and 2003
task1.prompt: The bar chart shows the average prices per kilometre of clothing imported into the European Union from six different countries in 1997 and 2003.

chartDesc.title: The average price per kilometre of clothing imported into the European Union
chartDesc.overview: Argentina had the highest average import price per kilometre in both years, while Bangladesh recorded the lowest. Overall, prices decreased in Argentina and Japan, remained static in Brazil, and rose in China, India, and Bangladesh.
keyFeatures: Argentina was the most expensive import source in both 1997 (£27.50) and 2003 (£25.50).
Bangladesh had the lowest import prices in both years (£3 in 1997, doubling to £6 in 2003).
China experienced the biggest price increase, growing from £10 in 1997 to £17 in 2003.
Brazil was the only country whose import price remained completely unchanged at £22.50.

task1.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features and make comparisons where relevant.
task1.sampleBand8:
The bar chart compares the average price per kilometre, in pounds, of clothing imported into the European Union from six countries in 1997 and 2003.

Overall, imports from the two South American countries were by far the most expensive in both years, while those from Asia were much cheaper. Prices from the wealthier suppliers generally fell or held steady, whereas the cost of clothing from the three Asian countries showed mixed movements, with India and Bangladesh becoming noticeably dearer.

Argentina supplied the costliest clothing throughout, though its price edged down from about £27.5 per kilometre in 1997 to £25.5 in 2003. Brazilian imports were the second most expensive and remained unchanged at roughly £22.5 in both years. Japan, the priciest of the Asian suppliers, saw its figure slip from £15 to £13 over the period.

The remaining Asian countries moved in the opposite direction. Chinese clothing rose substantially, from £10 to £17, overtaking Japan by 2003, while imports from India climbed from £7 to £12. Bangladesh supplied the cheapest clothing in both years, but its price still doubled, from £3 to £6. In short, the traditionally low-cost Asian exporters were closing the gap on their more expensive rivals.
task1.uzSampleBand8:
Ustunli diagramma 1997 va 2003-yillarda olti mamlakatdan Yevropa Ittifoqiga import qilingan kiyim-kechakning har kilometriga to'g'ri keladigan o'rtacha narxini funtlarda solishtiradi.

Umuman olganda, ikki Janubiy Amerika mamlakatidan kelgan import har ikki yilda ham beqiyos darajada eng qimmat bo'lgan, Osiyodan kelganlari esa ancha arzon edi. Badavlatroq yetkazib beruvchilardan narxlar odatda tushgan yoki barqaror qolgan, uch Osiyo mamlakatidan kelgan kiyim narxi esa aralash harakat ko'rsatib, Hindiston va Bangladeshniki sezilarli qimmatlashgan.

Argentina boshdan-oxir eng qimmat kiyim yetkazib berdi, garchi uning narxi 1997-yildagi har kilometriga taxminan 27,5 funtdan 2003-yilda 25,5 funtga bir oz pastlagan bo'lsa-da. Braziliya importi ikkinchi eng qimmati bo'lib, har ikki yilda ham taxminan 22,5 funtda o'zgarishsiz qoldi. Osiyo yetkazib beruvchilarining eng qimmati bo'lgan Yaponiya ko'rsatkichi esa davr mobaynida 15 funtdan 13 funtga tushdi.

Qolgan Osiyo mamlakatlari qarama-qarshi yo'nalishda harakatlandi. Xitoy kiyimi 10 funtdan 17 funtga sezilarli ko'tarilib, 2003-yilga kelib Yaponiyani ortda qoldirdi, Hindistondan import esa 7 funtdan 12 funtga chiqdi. Bangladesh har ikki yilda ham eng arzon kiyim yetkazib berdi, biroq uning narxi baribir 3 funtdan 6 funtga — ikki baravar oshdi. Qisqasi, an'anaviy arzon Osiyo eksportchilari o'zlarining qimmatroq raqiblari bilan farqni qisqartirib borayotgan edi.

task2.title: Will the spread of English outweigh its disadvantages?
task2.prompt: The advantages of the spread of English as a global language will continue to outweigh its disadvantages. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
task2.instruction: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
task2.sampleBand8:
English has become the world's dominant lingua franca, and it is often argued that the benefits of its spread will always exceed the drawbacks. Although I recognise the serious cultural costs involved, I broadly agree that, on balance, the advantages are the greater.

The gains from a shared global language are substantial and lasting. A common tongue allows scientists, doctors and businesspeople from different nations to collaborate directly, accelerating research and trade. It opens up education, since most academic material and online information appears first in English, and it makes international travel and diplomacy far smoother. For hundreds of millions of individuals, competence in English is a practical passport to better jobs and wider opportunity, and this usefulness is unlikely to fade.

Nevertheless, the disadvantages are real and should not be dismissed. As English spreads, smaller languages come under pressure and some are being driven towards extinction, taking with them unique cultures and ways of seeing the world. Native English speakers also enjoy an unfair advantage in global commerce and academia, while others must invest years mastering a second language. There is a risk, too, of a creeping cultural homogenisation in which local traditions are overshadowed by English-language media.

In conclusion, while the spread of English threatens linguistic diversity and creates inequalities, I believe its power to connect people, share knowledge and expand opportunity will continue to outweigh these costs — provided that deliberate efforts are made to protect endangered languages alongside it.
task2.uzSampleBand8:
Ingliz tili dunyoning hukmron umumiy muloqot tiliga aylandi va uning tarqalishidan foyda doimo zararidan ustun bo'ladi, deb tez-tez aytiladi. Bunga bog'liq jiddiy madaniy xarajatlarni tan olsam-da, umumiy hisobda afzalliklar ustunroq ekaniga asosan qo'shilaman.

Umumiy global tildan olinadigan yutuqlar salmoqli va uzoq muddatli. Umumiy til turli millatlardan bo'lgan olimlar, shifokorlar va tadbirkorlarga bevosita hamkorlik qilish imkonini berib, tadqiqot va savdoni tezlashtiradi. U ta'lim eshiklarini ochadi, chunki aksariyat ilmiy material va onlayn axborot avval ingliz tilida paydo bo'ladi, xalqaro sayohat va diplomatiyani esa ancha silliqlashtiradi. Yuzlab million odam uchun ingliz tilini bilish yaxshiroq ish va kengroq imkoniyatga amaliy pasport bo'lib, bu foydalilik so'nishi dargumon.

Shunga qaramay, kamchiliklar ham real va ularni e'tibordan soqit qilmaslik kerak. Ingliz tili tarqalgani sari kichikroq tillar bosim ostida qoladi, ba'zilari esa noyob madaniyatlar va dunyoni ko'rish tarzlarini o'zi bilan olib ketib, yo'q bo'lib ketishga surilmoqda. Ona tili ingliz bo'lganlar ham global savdo va akademiyada nohaq ustunlikdan bahramand bo'ladi, boshqalar esa ikkinchi tilni egallashga yillarini sarflashi kerak. Mahalliy an'analar ingliz tilidagi media soyasida qolib ketadigan madaniy bir xillashuv xavfi ham bor.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, ingliz tilining tarqalishi lingvistik xilma-xillikka tahdid solib, tengsizliklar yaratsa-da, uning odamlarni bog'lash, bilim ulashish va imkoniyatni kengaytirish qudrati bu xarajatlardan ustun bo'lib qolaveradi deb hisoblayman — faqat u bilan bir qatorda yo'qolib borayotgan tillarni himoya qilishga qaratilgan maqsadli sa'y-harakatlar qilinsa bas.
